Privacy Policy

When you submit a form, NI Group may collect the information you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, company name, project or service interest, message, newsletter email address, and the page from which you contacted us. Career applications may also include a CV file.

We use this information to respond to enquiries, provide requested project information, manage newsletter subscriptions, and review job applications. For project brochure requests, we email a confirmation to the address you provide and send the enquiry details to NI Group's sales team. Website form records are stored in a Google Spreadsheet, and CV files are stored in a restricted Google Drive folder managed by NI Group. Google services process this information to provide the storage, email, and form infrastructure.

Information is retained as needed for these purposes and applicable business or legal requirements. To ask to access, correct, or remove information, or to unsubscribe from newsletter communications, email info@nigrouprealty.com. Please do not submit passwords, payment-card information, or other sensitive information through website forms.
